newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.03 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.03 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.03 percent to close at 1.0255 against the dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

Dollar inflows helped to calm the market, after two days of deficits, dealers added. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Thursday surplus of $55 million.
Dealers said they will continue looking at dollar flows and the local currency would fall again on new outflows.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0312 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.27 percent to close at 1.095 per greenback, traders said.
